newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT-Astra, Perez Companc down/Ciadea up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Astra, Perez Companc down/Ciadea up.

text.p: - Caspian Securities said the swift run-up in Argentine markets over the past month has prompted it to downgrade both Astra and Perez Companc from buy to market performer.
- "Both stocks are now within reach of our YE97 targets, and we do not see either stock outperforming the Merval in the short term," it said in an investor note.

- Caspian's target on Perez Companc is $7.50 for the end of 1997 and the current price is $7.31. "While we continue to like the company's fundamentals and see very strong earnings grwoth this year of 29 percent, much of this is already factored into the stock's price."
- Its price target for Astra was $2.09 and the stock now stands at $2.04.
- "After an encouraging meeting with management, we are upgrading Ciadea to a buy from market performer with a 12-month price target of US$6, implying a 22 percent upside," Caspian added.
- It is raising its estimates of Ciadea's 1996 EPS 25 percent to $US0.13, 1997 EPS 5.0 percent to US$0.43 and 38 percent for 1998 to US$0.59.
